claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: When sufficiently concentrated aqueous silver and chloride ions are mixed, which sparingly soluble solid can precipitate? When the ion product exceeds the solubility product, silver and chloride ions can form solid AgCl. At equilibrium a small amount remains dissolved; precipitation depends on concentrations.
